| description = Higher level and much more difficult than [[a tundra yeti]].  Harder hitting and more AC, slightly higher resists (but not extreme).  Good to charm kill around 47 or 48.  

While they seem to share the same drop table of [[a tundra yeti]] (minus {{:Essence of Winter}}), the gem drops are much more rare.  They will drop [[Frosty Datura]] more often and frequent double drops of it, stacks sell decently at vendor (~24pp per stack).

Total of 7 spawns in middle cave in zone, 4 static in back, 3 roaming the halls.
